elements_not_encoded.text: Treat the HIV positive patient in labour
elements_not_encoded.reason: Header of a treatment-only box ('Treat ...'); it introduces management steps, not triage criteria, so it triggers no rule.

elements_not_encoded.text: Note: fill 'C#DELIVERY' on blood request form code field so that VL not rejected.
elements_not_encoded.reason: Administrative note on filling the blood request form; no clinical criterion.

elements_not_encoded.text: If on ART, continue ART throughout delivery. Check viral load, regardless of when last done, and review results at 3-6 day postnatal visit.
elements_not_encoded.reason: Continue ART and order a viral load; treatment and lab ordering. Viral load also has no unit/observable in the language.

elements_not_encoded.text: If not on ART, give together single dose NVP 200mg as early as possible in labour and single dose TLD: TDF/3TC/DTG 300/300/50mg.
elements_not_encoded.reason: Medicines and doses (NVP, TLD); out of scope per the no-manage-tasks decision.

elements_not_encoded.text: Give ideally during early labour, and urgently if delivery is imminent.
elements_not_encoded.reason: Timing of the medicine doses; management detail.

elements_not_encoded.text: Start patient on ART next day 126. Give 2 months ART supply.
elements_not_encoded.reason: Start ART and supply; management step with a cross-reference to page 126.

elements_not_encoded.text: Decide HIV transmission risk of HIV-exposed baby and give infant prophylaxis according to risk 186.
elements_not_encoded.reason: Infant prophylaxis decision (for the baby, cross-reference to page 186); management, not adult triage.

elements_not_encoded.text: DTG - dolutegravir; FTC – emtricitabine; NVP - nevirapine; TDF – tenofovir; 3TC – lamivudine, TLD - TDF/3TC/DTG or tenofovir/lamivudine/dolutegravir

judgment_calls.decision: The only red box ('Treat the HIV positive patient in labour') contains only management steps (ART, NVP/TLD doses, viral load, infant prophylaxis). The rest of the page is advice, treatment and review scheduling, with no 'X likely', 'consider X' or urgent-attention criteria. The .lisp file therefore holds only the page comment.
judgment_calls.alternatives: A check_for task triggered by HIV + labour (e.g. checking ART status), considered and rejected: no rule on this page would consume it (constraint 2), and it would be a management prompt, not triage.
